subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed first rides for {Brand} across Johannesburg, Cape Town, and Durban. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the completed ride, the first paid trip that settles, and read it back through a server-to-server postback from your stack via your MMP, so cancelled trips drop out before billing. That lets us hold around 2,400 validated completed first rides a day at licensed-operator rider quality. If it helps, I can pull the city-level completion read for your live metros. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-ride settlement proof
illustrative_flags: 2,400 validated completed first rides a day (MobUpps, illustrative)
